(eval_instructions == 'right'))\\n\\n    return performance, int(correct_left), int(correct_right)\\n\\n\\ndef load_nwb_session(nwb_path):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load all needed data from a single NWB file.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    import pynwb\\n\\n    io = pynwb.NWBHDF5IO(nwb_path, 'r')\\n    nwb = io.read()\\n\\n    # === Subject info ===\\n    subject_id = nwb.subject.subject_id\\n    subject_desc = nwb.subject.description  # e.g., \\\"SC015\\\"\\n\\n    # === Units (neural data) ===\\n    units = nwb.units\\n    n_units = len(units)\\n\\n    classifications = units['classification'][:]\\n    good_mask = classifications == 'good'\\n    anno_names = units['anno_name'][:]\\n\\n    # Get spike times for good units\\n    # units['spike_times'] is a VectorIndex wrapping VectorData\\n    # .target.data contains all actual spike time values\\n    # .data contains cumulative end indices for each unit\\n    spike_times_vi = units['spike_times']  # VectorIndex\\n    all_spike_times = np.array(spike_times_vi.target.data[:])  # actual spike times\\n    all_st_idx = np.array(spike_times_vi.data[:])  # end indices per unit\\n\\n    # Build spike times list for good units\\n    good_indices = np.where(good_mask)[0]\\n    good_spike_times = []\\n\\n    for ui in good_indices:\\n        start_idx = 0 if ui == 0 else int(all_st_idx[ui - 1])\\n        end_idx = int(all_st_idx[ui])\\n        good_spike_times.append(all_spike_times[start_idx:end_idx])\\n\\n    good_anno_names = anno_names[good_mask]\\n\\n    # === Trials ===\\n    trials = nwb.trials\\n    n_trials = len(trials)\\n    trials_data = {\\n        'start_time': trials['start_time'][:],\\n        'stop_time': trials['stop_time'][:],\\n        'trial_instruction': trials['trial_instruction'][:],\\n        'outcome': trials['outcome'][:],\\n        'early_lick': trials['early_lick'][:],\\n        'auto_water': trials['auto_water'][:],\\n        'free_water': trials['free_water'][:],\\n        'photostim_onset': trials['photostim_onset'][:],\\n        'photostim_power': trials['photostim_power'][:],\\n        'photostim_duration': trials['photostim_duration'][:],\\n    }\\n\\n    # === Behavioral events ===\\n    be = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralEvents']\\n    go_times = be.time_series['go_start_times'].timestamps[:]\\n\\n    # Sample start times (may have more entries than trials due to early lick replays)\\n    sample_start_ts = be.time_series['sample_start_times'].timestamps[:]\\n\\n    # Photostim events\\n    photostim_start_ts = be.time_series['photostim_start_times'].timestamps[:]\\n    photostim_stop_ts = be.time_series['photostim_stop_times'].timestamps[:]\\n\\n    # Lick times\\n    left_lick_ts = be.time_series['left_lick_times'].timestamps[:]\\n    right_lick_ts = be.time_series['right_lick_times'].timestamps[:]\\n\\n    # === Tongue tracking ===\\n    bts = nwb.acquisition['BehavioralTimeSeries']\\n    tongue_ts_obj = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking']\\n    tongue_data = tongue_ts_obj.data[:]  # (n_frames, 3): x, y, confidence\\n    tongue_timestamps = tongue_ts_obj.timestamps[:]\\n\\n    io.close()\\n\\n    return {\\n        'subject_id': subject_id,\\n        'subject_desc': subject_desc,\\n        'nwb_path': nwb_path,\\n        'good_spike_times': good_spike_times,\\n        'good_anno_names': good_anno_names,\\n        'good_indices': good_indices,\\n        'n_total_units': n_units,\\n        'trials_data': trials_data,\\n        'n_trials': n_trials,\\n        'go_times': go_times,\\n        'sample_start_ts': sample_start_ts,\\n        'photostim_start_ts': photostim_start_ts,\\n        'photostim_stop_ts': photostim_stop_ts,\\n        'left_lick_ts': left_lick_ts,\\n        'right_lick_ts': right_lick_ts,\\n        'tongue_data': tongue_data,\\n        'tongue_timestamps': tongue_timestamps,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef get_tone_onset_for_trials(go_times, sample_start_ts, trial_starts, trial_stops):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Get the last sample start time before go cue for each trial.\\n\\n    The sample epoch may replay due to early licks, so we take the LAST\\n    sample start event within each trial's time range (before go cue).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n    tone_onsets = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)\\n\\n    for i in range(n_trials):\\n        # Find sample starts within this trial, before the go cue\\n        mask = (sample_start_ts >= trial_starts[i]) & (sample_start_ts <= go_times[i])\\n        matching = sample_start_ts[mask]\\n        if len(matching) > 0:\\n            tone_onsets[i] = matching[-1]  # last sample start\\n\\n    return tone_onsets\\n\\n\\ndef bin_spikes(spike_times_list, go_times, align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Bin spike times into firing rates for each trial.\\n\\n    Vectorized implementation: processes all trials for each neuron at once.\\n\\n    Args:\\n        spike_times_list: list of arrays, one per neuron (absolute session times)\\n        go_times: array of go cue times (one per trial)\\n        align_start: time before go cue (negative)\\n        align_end: time after go cue (positive)\\n        bin_width: bin width in seconds\\n        n_bins: number of bins\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        list of (n_neurons, n_bins) arrays, one per trial\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_neurons = len(spike_times_list)\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n\\n    # Precompute bin edges relative to alignment\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(align_start, align_end, n_bins + 1)\\n\\n    # Pre-allocate all trial matrices at once: (n_trials, n_neurons, n_bins)\\n    all_matrices = np.zeros((n_trials, n_neurons, n_bins), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    for n in range(n_neurons):\\n        st = spike_times_list[n]\\n        if len(st) == 0:\\n            continue\\n\\n        # For each go time, compute relative spike times and bin them\\n        # Vectorize across trials using searchsorted\\n        for t in range(n_trials):\\n            go_t = go_times[t]\\n            # Get spikes in window using searchsorted (binary search)\\n            abs_start = go_t + align_start\\n            abs_end = go_t + align_end\\n            idx_lo = np.searchsorted(st, abs_start, side='left')\\n            idx_hi = np.searchsorted(st, abs_end, side='left')\\n\\n            if idx_hi > idx_lo:\\n                rel_spikes = st[idx_lo:idx_hi] - go_t\\n                counts, _ = np.histogram(rel_spikes, bins=bin_edges)\\n                all_matrices[t, n, :] = counts / bin_width\\n\\n    # Convert to list of (n_neurons, n_bins) per trial\\n    return [all_matrices[t] for t in range(n_trials)]\\n\\n\\ndef compute_tongue_y_per_trial(tongue_data, tongue_timestamps, go_times,\\n                                align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins,\\n                                confidence_threshold=TONGUE_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute tongue y-position time series for each trial, binned.\\n\\n    When tongue is occluded (confidence below threshold), set to session mean.\\n    Reference: \\\"when the tongue was occluded... we set the tongue position to its mean value\\\"\\n\\n    Vectorized implementation for efficiency.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    tongue_y = tongue_data[:, 1].astype(np.float64)\\n    tongue_conf = tongue_data[:, 2].astype(np.float64)\\n\\n    # Compute session mean of tongue y when visible\\n    visible_mask = tongue_conf >= confidence_threshold\\n    if np.sum(visible_mask) > 0:\\n        session_mean_y = np.mean(tongue_y[visible_mask])\\n    else:\\n        session_mean_y = np.mean(tongue_y)\\n\\n    # Replace non-visible tongue y with session mean (vectorized)\\n    tongue_y_imputed = tongue_y.copy()\\n    tongue_y_imputed[~visible_mask] = session_mean_y\\n\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(align_start, align_end, n_bins + 1)\\n\\n    tongue_y_trials = []\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\n\\n        # Get tongue data in the trial window\\n        window_start = go_t + align_start\\n        window_end = go_t + align_end\\n        mask = (tongue_timestamps >= window_start) & (tongue_timestamps < window_end)\\n        trial_ts = tongue_timestamps[mask] - go_t  # relative to go cue\\n        trial_y = tongue_y_imputed[mask]\\n\\n        if len(trial_ts) == 0:\\n            tongue_y_trials.append(np.full(n_bins, session_mean_y, dtype=np.float32))\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Bin the tongue y values using digitize (vectorized)\\n        bin_indices = np.digitize(trial_ts, bin_edges) - 1  # 0-indexed bins\\n        bin_indices = np.clip(bin_indices, 0, n_bins - 1)\\n\\n        trial_tongue_y = np.full(n_bins, session_mean_y, dtype=np.float64)\\n        # Use bincount for mean computation\\n        for b in range(n_bins):\\n            in_bin = trial_y[bin_indices == b]\\n            if len(in_bin) > 0:\\n                trial_tongue_y[b] = np.mean(in_bin)\\n\\n        tongue_y_trials.append(trial_tongue_y.astype(np.float32))\\n\\n    return tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y\\n\\n\\ndef discretize_tongue_y(tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Discretize tongue y-position per session.\\n\\n    0: < 40th percentile of y-position over the session\\n    1: 40th to 60th percentile of y-position over the session\\n    2: > 60th percentile of y-position over the session\\n\\n    Percentiles are computed over ALL time bins (including imputed values).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Collect all tongue y values across all trials and time bins\\n    all_values = np.concatenate([t for t in tongue_y_trials])\\n\\n    p40 = np.percentile(all_values, 40)\\n    p60 = np.percentile(all_values, 60)\\n\\n    # Ensure thresholds differ to get 3 categories\\n    # If p40 == p60 (common when tongue is mostly at mean), adjust slightly\\n    if np.isclose(p40, p60):\\n        # Use small offset to create 3 categories\\n        eps = max(1e-6, abs(p40) * 1e-4)\\n        p40 = p40 - eps\\n        p60 = p60 + eps\\n\\n    discretized = []\\n    for trial_y in tongue_y_trials:\\n        d = np.zeros(len(trial_y), dtype=np.int64)\\n        d[trial_y >= p40] = 1\\n        d[trial_y >= p60] = 2\\n        discretized.append(d)\\n\\n    return discretized\\n\\n\\ndef compute_photostim_input(go_times, photostim_start_ts, photostim_stop_ts,\\n                            align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute binary photostimulation time series for each trial.\\n\\n    1 when photostim is active, 0 otherwise.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(align_start + bin_width/2, align_end - bin_width/2, n_bins)\\n\\n    photostim_trials = []\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\n        ps = np.zeros(n_bins, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n        for si in range(len(photostim_start_ts)):\\n            ps_start = photostim_start_ts[si] - go_t\\n            ps_stop = photostim_stop_ts[si] - go_t\\n\\n            # Check if this photostim event overlaps with our window\\n            if ps_stop < align_start or ps_start > align_end:\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Mark bins where photostim is active\\n            for b in range(n_bins):\\n                bc = bin_centers[b]\\n                if bc >= ps_start and bc < ps_stop:\\n                    ps[b] = 1.0\\n\\n        photostim_trials.append(ps)\\n\\n    return photostim_trials\\n\\n\\ndef compute_tone_onset_input(go_times, tone_onsets, align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute time from tone onset for each trial and time bin.\\n\\n    This is a continuous, time-varying input: time (in seconds) since the\\n    tone (sample stimulus) began.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(align_start + bin_width/2, align_end - bin_width/2, n_bins)\\n\\n    tone_onset_input = []\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\n        tone_t = tone_onsets[t]\\n\\n        if np.isnan(tone_t):\\n            # If no tone onset found, set to 0 (shouldn't happen for valid trials)\\n            tone_input = np.zeros(n_bins, dtype=np.float32)\\n        else:\\n            # Time from tone onset = (absolute time of bin center) - tone_onset\\n            # = (go_t + bin_center) - tone_t\\n            # = bin_center - (tone_t - go_t)\\n            tone_rel = tone_t - go_t  # tone onset relative to go cue (negative)\\n            tone_input = (bin_centers - tone_rel).astype(np.float32)\\n\\n        tone_onset_input.append(tone_input)\\n\\n    return tone_onset_input\\n\\n\\ndef process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process a single NWB session into decoder format.\\n\\n    Returns None if session doesn't meet selection criteria.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    t0 = time.time()\\n    sess_name = os.path.basename(nwb_path).replace('.nwb', '')\\n    print(f'  Loading {sess_name}...')\\n\\n    data = load_nwb_session(nwb_path)\\n    t_load = time.time() - t0\\n\\n    # === Session selection criteria ===\\n    performance, correct_left, correct_right = compute_session_performance(data['trials_data'])\\n    print(f'    Performance: {performance:.1%}, Correct L/R: {correct_left}/{correct_right}')\\n\\n    if performance < MIN_PERFORMANCE:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: performance {performance:.1%} < {MIN_PERFORMANCE:.0%}')\\n        return None\\n    if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_LEFT:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: correct left {correct_left} < {MIN_CORRECT_LEFT}')\\n        return None\\n    if correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: correct right {correct_right} < {MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT}')\\n        return None\\n\\n    # === Trial filtering: exclude auto_water and free_water ===\\n    td = data['trials_data']\\n    trial_mask = np.ones(data['n_trials'], dtype=bool)\\n    trial_mask[td['auto_water'] == 1] = False\\n    trial_mask[td['free_water'] == 1] = False\\n\\n    # Get trial indices\\n    trial_indices = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\n    n_valid_trials = len(trial_indices)\\n\\n    if n_valid_trials < 2:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: only {n_valid_trials} valid trials')\\n        return None\\n\\n    go_times = data['go_times'][trial_indices]\\n\\n    # === Neuron filtering: only good units with valid brain region ===\\n    good_anno = data['good_anno_names']\\n    region_labels = []\\n    neuron_mask = []\\n    for i, anno in enumerate(good_anno):\\n        region = map_anno_to_region(anno)\\n        if region is not None:\\n            region_labels.append(region)\\n            neuron_mask.append(i)\\n\\n    neuron_mask = np.array(neuron_mask)\\n    n_neurons = len(neuron_mask)\\n\\n    if n_neurons < 1:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: no neurons with valid brain region')\\n        return None\\n\\n    spike_times_list = [data['good_spike_times'][i] for i in neuron_mask]\\n\\n    # === Exclude trials beyond recording range ===\\n    # Some sessions have behavioral trials before recording starts or after it ends.\\n    # Find the min/max spike time across all selected neurons.\\n    max_spike_time = max(\\n        (st[-1] if len(st) > 0 else 0.0) for st in spike_times_list\\n    )\\n    min_spike_time = min(\\n        (st[0] if len(st) > 0 else float('inf')) for st in spike_times_list\\n    )\\n    # A trial needs neural data in [go_time + ALIGN_START, go_time + ALIGN_END].\\n    # Exclude trials where the window doesn't overlap with recorded data.\\n    recording_mask = (go_times + ALIGN_START <= max_spike_time) & \\\\\\n                     (go_times + ALIGN_END >= min_spike_time)\\n    if not np.all(recording_mask):\\n        n_dropped = np.sum(~recording_mask)\\n        print(f'    Excluding {n_dropped} trials beyond recording range (max spike: {max_spike_time:.1f}s)')\\n        # Update trial_indices and go_times\\n        valid_positions = np.where(recording_mask)[0]\\n        trial_indices = trial_indices[valid_positions]\\n        go_times = go_times[valid_positions]\\n        n_valid_trials = len(trial_indices)\\n        if n_valid_trials < 2:\\n            print(f'    SKIP: only {n_valid_trials} valid trials after recording filter')\\n            return None\\n\\n    print(f'    Neurons: {n_neurons}, Trials: {n_valid_trials} (loaded in {t_load:.1f}s)')\\n\\n    # === Bin spikes into firing rates ===\\n    t1 = time.time()\\n    neural_trials = bin_spikes(spike_times_list, go_times, ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS)\\n    t_bin = time.time() - t1\\n    print(f'    Spike binning: {t_bin:.1f}s')\\n\\n    # === Compute inputs ===\\n    # 1. Time from tone onset\\n    tone_onsets = get_tone_onset_for_trials(\\n        go_times, data['sample_start_ts'],\\n        td['start_time'][trial_indices], td['stop_time'][trial_indices]\\n    )\\n    tone_onset_input = compute_tone_onset_input(go_times, tone_onsets, ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS)\\n\\n    # 2. Photostimulation\\n    photostim_input = compute_photostim_input(go_times, data['photostim_start_ts'],\\n                                               data['photostim_stop_ts'],\\n                                               ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS)\\n\\n    # Combine inputs: (2, n_bins)\\n    input_trials = []\\n    for t in range(n_valid_trials):\\n        inp = np.stack([tone_onset_input[t], photostim_input[t]], axis=0).astype(np.float32)\\n        input_trials.append(inp)\\n\\n    # === Compute outputs ===\\n    # 1. Choice: left=0, right=1\\n    instructions = td['trial_instruction'][trial_indices]\\n    choices = np.array([0 if ins == 'left' else 1 for ins in instructions], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # 2. Outcome: ignore=0, miss=1, hit=2\\n    outcomes_raw = td['outcome'][trial_indices]\\n    outcome_map = {'ignore': 0, 'miss': 1, 'hit': 2}\\n    outcomes = np.array([outcome_map.get(o, 0) for o in outcomes_raw], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # 3. Early lick: no=0, yes=1\\n    early_lick_raw = td['early_lick'][trial_indices]\\n    early_licks = np.array([1 if el == 'early' else 0 for el in early_lick_raw], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # 4. Tongue y-position (time-varying, discretized)\\n    t2 = time.time()\\n    tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y = compute_tongue_y_per_trial(\\n        data['tongue_data'], data['tongue_timestamps'], go_times,\\n        ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS\\n    )\\n    tongue_y_discrete = discretize_tongue_y(tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y)\\n    t_tongue = time.time() - t2\\n    print(f'    Tongue processing: {t_tongue:.1f}s')\\n\\n    # Combine outputs: per-trial for first 3, time-varying for tongue\\n    output_trials = []\\n    for t in range(n_valid_trials):\\n        out = np.array([\\n            np.full(N_BINS, choices[t], dtype=np.int64),         # choice (per-trial, broadcast)\\n            np.full(N_BINS, outcomes[t], dtype=np.int64),        # outcome (per-trial, broadcast)\\n            np.full(N_BINS, early_licks[t], dtype=np.int64),     # early lick (per-trial, broadcast)\\n            tongue_y_discrete[t].astype(np.int64),                # tongue y (time-varying)\\n        ], dtype=np.int64)\\n        output_trials.append(out)\\n\\n    # === Plotting ===\\n    if show_processing:\\n        plot_processing(sess_name, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\n                       go_times, tone_onsets, tongue_y_trials, tongue_y_discrete,\\n                       region_labels, session_idx)\\n\\n    total_time = time.time() - t0\\n    print(f'    Total: {total_time:.1f}s')\\n\\n    return {\\n        'neural': neural_trials,          # list of (n_neurons, n_bins)\\n        'input': input_trials,            # list of (2, n_bins)\\n        'output': output_trials,          # list of (4, n_bins)\\n        'subject_id': data['subject_id'],\\n        'subject_desc': data['subject_desc'],\\n        'region_labels': region_labels,   # list of str, length n_neurons\\n        'n_neurons': n_neurons,\\n        'n_trials': n_valid_trials,\\n        'performance': performance,\\n        'correct_left': correct_left,\\n        'correct_right': correct_right,\\n        'nwb_path': nwb_path,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef plot_processing(sess_name, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\n                   go_times, tone_onsets, tongue_y_raw, tongue_y_discrete,\\n                   region_labels, session_idx):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Plot visualizations of processing steps.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    import matplotlib\\n    matplotlib.use('Agg')\\n    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\n\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(ALIGN_START + BIN_WIDTH/2, ALIGN_END - BIN_WIDTH/2, N_BINS)\\n\\n    fig, axes = plt.subplots(5, 2, figsize=(16, 20))\\n    fig.suptitle(f'Processing: {sess_name}', fontsize=14)\\n\\n    # Pick example trial\\n    n_trials = len(neural_trials)\\n    trial_idx = min(5, n_trials - 1)\\n\\n    # 1. Neural activity heatmap for example trial\\n    ax = axes[0, 0]\\n    neural = neural_trials[trial_idx]\\n    n_show = min(50, neural.shape[0])\\n    ax.imshow(neural[:n_show], aspect='auto', extent=[ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, n_show, 0])\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Go cue')\\n    ax.set_title(f'Neural (trial {trial_idx}, first {n_show} neurons)')\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\n    ax.set_ylabel('Neuron')\\n    ax.legend()\\n\\n    # 2. Mean firing rate across neurons\\n    ax = axes[0, 1]\\n    mean_fr = np.mean([np.mean(t, axis=0) for t in neural_trials], axis=0)\\n    ax.plot(bin_centers, mean_fr)\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Go cue')\\n    ax.set_title('Mean firing rate (all trials, all neurons)')\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\n    ax.set_ylabel('Firing rate (Hz)')\\n    ax.legend()\\n\\n    # 3. good_spike_times,\\\\n        'good_anno_names': good_anno_names,\\\\n        'good_indices': good_indices,\\\\n        'n_total_units': n_units,\\\\n        'trials_data': trials_data,\\\\n        'n_trials': n_trials,\\\\n        'go_times': go_times,\\\\n        'sample_start_ts': sample_start_ts,\\\\n        'photostim_start_ts': photostim_start_ts,\\\\n        'photostim_stop_ts': photostim_stop_ts,\\\\n        'left_lick_ts': left_lick_ts,\\\\n        'right_lick_ts': right_lick_ts,\\\\n        'tongue_data': tongue_data,\\\\n        'tongue_timestamps': tongue_timestamps,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef get_tone_onset_for_trials(go_times, sample_start_ts, trial_starts, trial_stops):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Get the last sample start time before go cue for each trial.\\\\n\\\\n    The sample epoch may replay due to early licks, so we take the LAST\\\\n    sample start event within each trial's time range (before go cue).\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\\\n    tone_onsets = np.full(n_trials, np.nan)\\\\n\\\\n    for i in range(n_trials):\\\\n        # Find sample starts within this trial, before the go cue\\\\n        mask = (sample_start_ts >= trial_starts[i]) & (sample_start_ts <= go_times[i])\\\\n        matching = sample_start_ts[mask]\\\\n        if len(matching) > 0:\\\\n            tone_onsets[i] = matching[-1]  # last sample start\\\\n\\\\n    return tone_onsets\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef bin_spikes(spike_times_list, go_times, align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Bin spike times into firing rates for each trial.\\\\n\\\\n    Vectorized implementation: processes all trials for each neuron at once.\\\\n\\\\n    Args:\\\\n        spike_times_list: list of arrays, one per neuron (absolute session times)\\\\n        go_times: array of go cue times (one per trial)\\\\n        align_start: time before go cue (negative)\\\\n        align_end: time after go cue (positive)\\\\n        bin_width: bin width in seconds\\\\n        n_bins: number of bins\\\\n\\\\n    Returns:\\\\n        list of (n_neurons, n_bins) arrays, one per trial\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n_neurons = len(spike_times_list)\\\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\\\n\\\\n    # Precompute bin edges relative to alignment\\\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(align_start, align_end, n_bins + 1)\\\\n\\\\n    # Pre-allocate all trial matrices at once: (n_trials, n_neurons, n_bins)\\\\n    all_matrices = np.zeros((n_trials, n_neurons, n_bins), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n\\\\n    for n in range(n_neurons):\\\\n        st = spike_times_list[n]\\\\n        if len(st) == 0:\\\\n            continue\\\\n\\\\n        # For each go time, compute relative spike times and bin them\\\\n        # Vectorize across trials using searchsorted\\\\n        for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n            go_t = go_times[t]\\\\n            # Get spikes in window using searchsorted (binary search)\\\\n            abs_start = go_t + align_start\\\\n            abs_end = go_t + align_end\\\\n            idx_lo = np.searchsorted(st, abs_start, side='left')\\\\n            idx_hi = np.searchsorted(st, abs_end, side='left')\\\\n\\\\n            if idx_hi > idx_lo:\\\\n                rel_spikes = st[idx_lo:idx_hi] - go_t\\\\n                counts, _ = np.histogram(rel_spikes, bins=bin_edges)\\\\n                all_matrices[t, n, :] = counts / bin_width\\\\n\\\\n    # Convert to list of (n_neurons, n_bins) per trial\\\\n    return [all_matrices[t] for t in range(n_trials)]\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_tongue_y_per_trial(tongue_data, tongue_timestamps, go_times,\\\\n                                align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins,\\\\n                                confidence_threshold=TONGUE_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute tongue y-position time series for each trial, binned.\\\\n\\\\n    When tongue is occluded (confidence below threshold), set to session mean.\\\\n    Reference: \\\\\\\"when the tongue was occluded... we set the tongue position to its mean value\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n    Vectorized implementation for efficiency.\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    tongue_y = tongue_data[:, 1].astype(np.float64)\\\\n    tongue_conf = tongue_data[:, 2].astype(np.float64)\\\\n\\\\n    # Compute session mean of tongue y when visible\\\\n    visible_mask = tongue_conf >= confidence_threshold\\\\n    if np.sum(visible_mask) > 0:\\\\n        session_mean_y = np.mean(tongue_y[visible_mask])\\\\n    else:\\\\n        session_mean_y = np.mean(tongue_y)\\\\n\\\\n    # Replace non-visible tongue y with session mean (vectorized)\\\\n    tongue_y_imputed = tongue_y.copy()\\\\n    tongue_y_imputed[~visible_mask] = session_mean_y\\\\n\\\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(align_start, align_end, n_bins + 1)\\\\n\\\\n    tongue_y_trials = []\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\\\n\\\\n        # Get tongue data in the trial window\\\\n        window_start = go_t + align_start\\\\n        window_end = go_t + align_end\\\\n        mask = (tongue_timestamps >= window_start) & (tongue_timestamps < window_end)\\\\n        trial_ts = tongue_timestamps[mask] - go_t  # relative to go cue\\\\n        trial_y = tongue_y_imputed[mask]\\\\n\\\\n        if len(trial_ts) == 0:\\\\n            tongue_y_trials.append(np.full(n_bins, session_mean_y, dtype=np.float32))\\\\n            continue\\\\n\\\\n        # Bin the tongue y values using digitize (vectorized)\\\\n        bin_indices = np.digitize(trial_ts, bin_edges) - 1  # 0-indexed bins\\\\n        bin_indices = np.clip(bin_indices, 0, n_bins - 1)\\\\n\\\\n        trial_tongue_y = np.full(n_bins, session_mean_y, dtype=np.float64)\\\\n        # Use bincount for mean computation\\\\n        for b in range(n_bins):\\\\n            in_bin = trial_y[bin_indices == b]\\\\n            if len(in_bin) > 0:\\\\n                trial_tongue_y[b] = np.mean(in_bin)\\\\n\\\\n        tongue_y_trials.append(trial_tongue_y.astype(np.float32))\\\\n\\\\n    return tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretize_tongue_y(tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretize tongue y-position per session.\\\\n\\\\n    0: < 40th percentile of y-position over the session\\\\n    1: 40th to 60th percentile of y-position over the session\\\\n    2: > 60th percentile of y-position over the session\\\\n\\\\n    Percentiles are computed over ALL time bins (including imputed values).\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    # Collect all tongue y values across all trials and time bins\\\\n    all_values = np.concatenate([t for t in tongue_y_trials])\\\\n\\\\n    p40 = np.percentile(all_values, 40)\\\\n    p60 = np.percentile(all_values, 60)\\\\n\\\\n    # Ensure thresholds differ to get 3 categories\\\\n    # If p40 == p60 (common when tongue is mostly at mean), adjust slightly\\\\n    if np.isclose(p40, p60):\\\\n        # Use small offset to create 3 categories\\\\n        eps = max(1e-6, abs(p40) * 1e-4)\\\\n        p40 = p40 - eps\\\\n        p60 = p60 + eps\\\\n\\\\n    discretized = []\\\\n    for trial_y in tongue_y_trials:\\\\n        d = np.zeros(len(trial_y), dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        d[trial_y >= p40] = 1\\\\n        d[trial_y >= p60] = 2\\\\n        discretized.append(d)\\\\n\\\\n    return discretized\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_photostim_input(go_times, photostim_start_ts, photostim_stop_ts,\\\\n                            align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute binary photostimulation time series for each trial.\\\\n\\\\n    1 when photostim is active, 0 otherwise.\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(align_start + bin_width/2, align_end - bin_width/2, n_bins)\\\\n\\\\n    photostim_trials = []\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\\\n        ps = np.zeros(n_bins, dtype=np.float32)\\\\n\\\\n        for si in range(len(photostim_start_ts)):\\\\n            ps_start = photostim_start_ts[si] - go_t\\\\n            ps_stop = photostim_stop_ts[si] - go_t\\\\n\\\\n            # Check if this photostim event overlaps with our window\\\\n            if ps_stop < align_start or ps_start > align_end:\\\\n                continue\\\\n\\\\n            # Mark bins where photostim is active\\\\n            for b in range(n_bins):\\\\n                bc = bin_centers[b]\\\\n                if bc >= ps_start and bc < ps_stop:\\\\n                    ps[b] = 1.0\\\\n\\\\n        photostim_trials.append(ps)\\\\n\\\\n    return photostim_trials\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_tone_onset_input(go_times, tone_onsets, align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute time from tone onset for each trial and time bin.\\\\n\\\\n    This is a continuous, time-varying input: time (in seconds) since the\\\\n    tone (sample stimulus) began.\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(align_start + bin_width/2, align_end - bin_width/2, n_bins)\\\\n\\\\n    tone_onset_input = []\\\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\\\n        tone_t = tone_onsets[t]\\\\n\\\\n        if np.isnan(tone_t):\\\\n            # If no tone onset found, set to 0 (shouldn't happen for valid trials)\\\\n            tone_input = np.zeros(n_bins, dtype=np.float32)\\\\n        else:\\\\n            # Time from tone onset = (absolute time of bin center) - tone_onset\\\\n            # = (go_t + bin_center) - tone_t\\\\n            # = bin_center - (tone_t - go_t)\\\\n            tone_rel = tone_t - go_t  # tone onset relative to go cue (negative)\\\\n            tone_input = (bin_centers - tone_rel).astype(np.float32)\\\\n\\\\n        tone_onset_input.append(tone_input)\\\\n\\\\n    return tone_onset_input\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Process a single NWB session into decoder format.\\\\n\\\\n    Returns None if session doesn't meet selection criteria.\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    t0 = time.time()\\\\n    sess_name = os.path.basename(nwb_path).replace('.nwb', '')\\\\n    print(f'  Loading {sess_name}...')\\\\n\\\\n    data = load_nwb_session(nwb_path)\\\\n    t_load = time.time() - t0\\\\n\\\\n    # === Session selection criteria ===\\\\n    performance, correct_left, correct_right = compute_session_performance(data['trials_data'])\\\\n    print(f'    Performance: {performance:.1%}, Correct L/R: {correct_left}/{correct_right}')\\\\n\\\\n    if performance < MIN_PERFORMANCE:\\\\n        print(f'    SKIP: performance {performance:.1%} < {MIN_PERFORMANCE:.0%}')\\\\n        return None\\\\n    if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_LEFT:\\\\n        print(f'    SKIP: correct left {correct_left} < {MIN_CORRECT_LEFT}')\\\\n        return None\\\\n    if correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT:\\\\n        print(f'    SKIP: correct right {correct_right} < {MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT}')\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    # === Trial filtering: exclude auto_water and free_water ===\\\\n    td = data['trials_data']\\\\n    trial_mask = np.ones(data['n_trials'], dtype=bool)\\\\n    trial_mask[td['auto_water'] == 1] = False\\\\n    trial_mask[td['free_water'] == 1] = False\\\\n\\\\n    # Get trial indices\\\\n    trial_indices = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\\\n    n_valid_trials = len(trial_indices)\\\\n\\\\n    if n_valid_trials < 2:\\\\n        print(f'    SKIP: only {n_valid_trials} valid trials')\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    go_times = data['go_times'][trial_indices]\\\\n\\\\n    # === Neuron filtering: only good units with valid brain region ===\\\\n    good_anno = data['good_anno_names']\\\\n    region_labels = []\\\\n    neuron_mask = []\\\\n    for i, anno in enumerate(good_anno):\\\\n        region = map_anno_to_region(anno)\\\\n        if region is not None:\\\\n            region_labels.append(region)\\\\n            neuron_mask.append(i)\\\\n\\\\n    neuron_mask = np.array(neuron_mask)\\\\n    n_neurons = len(neuron_mask)\\\\n\\\\n    if n_neurons < 1:\\\\n        print(f'    SKIP: no neurons with valid brain region')\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n    spike_times_list = [data['good_spike_times'][i] for i in neuron_mask]\\\\n\\\\n    # === Exclude trials beyond recording range ===\\\\n    # Some sessions have behavioral trials before recording starts or after it ends.\\\\n    # Find the min/max spike time across all selected neurons.\\\\n    max_spike_time = max(\\\\n        (st[-1] if len(st) > 0 else 0.0) for st in spike_times_list\\\\n    )\\\\n    min_spike_time = min(\\\\n        (st[0] if len(st) > 0 else float('inf')) for st in spike_times_list\\\\n    )\\\\n    # A trial needs neural data in [go_time + ALIGN_START, go_time + ALIGN_END].\\\\n    # Exclude trials where the window doesn't overlap with recorded data.\\\\n    recording_mask = (go_times + ALIGN_START <= max_spike_time) & \\\\\\\\\\\\n                     (go_times + ALIGN_END >= min_spike_time)\\\\n    if not np.all(recording_mask):\\\\n        n_dropped = np.sum(~recording_mask)\\\\n        print(f'    Excluding {n_dropped} trials beyond recording range (max spike: {max_spike_time:.1f}s)')\\\\n        # Update trial_indices and go_times\\\\n        valid_positions = np.where(recording_mask)[0]\\\\n        trial_indices = trial_indices[valid_positions]\\\\n        go_times = go_times[valid_positions]\\\\n        n_valid_trials = len(trial_indices)\\\\n        if n_valid_trials < 2:\\\\n            print(f'    SKIP: only {n_valid_trials} valid trials after recording filter')\\\\n            return None\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'    Neurons: {n_neurons}, Trials: {n_valid_trials} (loaded in {t_load:.1f}s)')\\\\n\\\\n    # === Bin spikes into firing rates ===\\\\n    t1 = time.time()\\\\n    neural_trials = bin_spikes(spike_times_list, go_times, ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS)\\\\n    t_bin = time.time() - t1\\\\n    print(f'    Spike binning: {t_bin:.1f}s')\\\\n\\\\n    # === Compute inputs ===\\\\n    # 1. Time from tone onset\\\\n    tone_onsets = get_tone_onset_for_trials(\\\\n        go_times, data['sample_start_ts'],\\\\n        td['start_time'][trial_indices], td['stop_time'][trial_indices]\\\\n    )\\\\n    tone_onset_input = compute_tone_onset_input(go_times, tone_onsets, ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS)\\\\n\\\\n    # 2. Photostimulation\\\\n    photostim_input = compute_photostim_input(go_times, data['photostim_start_ts'],\\\\n                                               data['photostim_stop_ts'],\\\\n                                               ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS)\\\\n\\\\n    # Combine inputs: (2, n_bins)\\\\n    input_trials = []\\\\n    for t in range(n_valid_trials):\\\\n        inp = np.stack([tone_onset_input[t], photostim_input[t]], axis=0).astype(np.float32)\\\\n        input_trials.append(inp)\\\\n\\\\n    # === Compute outputs ===\\\\n    # 1. Choice: left=0, right=1\\\\n    instructions = td['trial_instruction'][trial_indices]\\\\n    choices = np.array([0 if ins == 'left' else 1 for ins in instructions], dtype=np.int64)\\\\n\\\\n    # 2. Outcome: ignore=0, miss=1, hit=2\\\\n    outcomes_raw = td['outcome'][trial_indices]\\\\n    outcome_map = {'ignore': 0, 'miss': 1, 'hit': 2}\\\\n    outcomes = np.array([outcome_map.get(o, 0) for o in outcomes_raw], dtype=np.int64)\\\\n\\\\n    # 3. Early lick: no=0, yes=1\\\\n    early_lick_raw = td['early_lick'][trial_indices]\\\\n    early_licks = np.array([1 if el == 'early' else 0 for el in early_lick_raw], dtype=np.int64)\\\\n\\\\n    # 4. Tongue y-position (time-varying, discretized)\\\\n    t2 = time.time()\\\\n    tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y = compute_tongue_y_per_trial(\\\\n        data['tongue_data'], data['tongue_timestamps'], go_times,\\\\n        ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS\\\\n    )\\\\n    tongue_y_discrete = discretize_tongue_y(tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y)\\\\n    t_tongue = time.time() - t2\\\\n    print(f'    Tongue processing: {t_tongue:.1f}s')\\\\n\\\\n    # Combine outputs: per-trial for first 3, time-varying for tongue\\\\n    output_trials = []\\\\n    for t in range(n_valid_trials):\\\\n        out = np.array([\\\\n            np.full(N_BINS, choices[t], dtype=np.int64),         # choice (per-trial, broadcast)\\\\n            np.full(N_BINS, outcomes[t], dtype=np.int64),        # outcome (per-trial, broadcast)\\\\n            np.full(N_BINS, early_licks[t], dtype=np.int64),     # early lick (per-trial, broadcast)\\\\n            tongue_y_discrete[t].astype(np.int64),                # tongue y (time-varying)\\\\n        ], dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        output_trials.append(out)\\\\n\\\\n    # === Plotting ===\\\\n    if show_processing:\\\\n        plot_processing(sess_name, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\\\n                       go_times, tone_onsets, tongue_y_trials, tongue_y_discrete,\\\\n                       region_labels, session_idx)\\\\n\\\\n    total_time = time.time() - t0\\\\n    print(f'    Total: {total_time:.1f}s')\\\\n\\\\n    return {\\\\n        'neural': neural_trials,          # list of (n_neurons, n_bins)\\\\n        'input': input_trials,            # list of (2, n_bins)\\\\n        'output': output_trials,          # list of (4, n_bins)\\\\n        'subject_id': data['subject_id'],\\\\n        'subject_desc': data['subject_desc'],\\\\n        'region_labels': region_labels,   # list of str, length n_neurons\\\\n        'n_neurons': n_neurons,\\\\n        'n_trials': n_valid_trials,\\\\n        'performance': performance,\\\\n        'correct_left': correct_left,\\\\n        'correct_right': correct_right,\\\\n        'nwb_path': nwb_path,\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef plot_processing(sess_name, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\\\n                   go_times, tone_onsets, tongue_y_raw, tongue_y_discrete,\\\\n                   region_labels, session_idx):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Plot visualizations of processing steps.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    import matplotlib\\\\n    matplotlib.use('Agg')\\\\n    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\\\n\\\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(ALIGN_START + BIN_WIDTH/2, ALIGN_END - BIN_WIDTH/2, N_BINS)\\\\n\\\\n    fig, axes = plt.subplots(5, 2, figsize=(16, 20))\\\\n    fig.suptitle(f'Processing: {sess_name}', fontsize=14)\\\\n\\\\n    # Pick example trial\\\\n    n_trials = len(neural_trials)\\\\n    trial_idx = min(5, n_trials - 1)\\\\n\\\\n    # 1. Neural activity heatmap for example trial\\\\n    ax = axes[0, 0]\\\\n    neural = neural_trials[trial_idx]\\\\n    n_show = min(50, neural.shape[0])\\\\n    ax.imshow(neural[:n_show], aspect='auto', extent=[ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, n_show, 0])\\\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Go cue')\\\\n    ax.set_title(f'Neural (trial {trial_idx}, first {n_show} neurons)')\\\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\\\n    ax.set_ylabel('Neuron')\\\\n    ax.legend()\\\\n\\\\n    # 2. Mean firing rate across neurons\\\\n    ax = axes[0, 1]\\\\n    mean_fr = np.mean([np.mean(t, axis=0) for t in neural_trials], axis=0)\\\\n    ax.plot(bin_centers, mean_fr)\\\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Go cue')\\\\n    ax.set_title('Mean firing rate (all trials, all neurons)')\\\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\\\n    ax.set_ylabel('Firing rate (Hz)')\\\\n    ax.legend()\\\\n\\\\n    # 3. Input: time from tone onset\\\\n    ax = axes[1, 0]\\\\n    for t in range(min(10, n_trials)):\\\\n        ax.plot(bin_centers, input_trials[t][0], alpha=0.5)\\\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')\\\\n    ax.set_title('Input: Time from tone onset')\\\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\\\n    ax.set_ylabel('Time from tone (s)')\\\\n\\\\n    # 4. Input: photostimulation\\\\n    ax = axes[1, 1]\\\\n    ps_any = np.any([input_trials[t][1] for t in range(n_trials)], axis=0)\\\\n    n_stim = sum(1 for t in range(n_trials) if np.any(input_trials[t][1] > 0))\\\\n    ax.plot(bin_centers, np.mean([input_trials[t][1] for t in range(n_trials)], axis=0))\\\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')\\\\n    ax.set_title(f'Input: Photostim (mean, {n_stim}/{n_trials} stim trials)')\\\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\\\n    ax.set_ylabel('P(stim on)')\\\\n\\\\n    # 5. Output: choice distribution\\\\n    ax = axes[2, 0]\\\\n    choices = [output_trials[t][0, 0] for t in range(n_trials)]\\\\n    ax.bar(['Left (0)', 'Right (1)'], [choices.count(0), choices.count(1)])\\\\n    ax.set_title('Output: Choice distribution')\\\\n\\\\n    # 6. Output: outcome distribution\\\\n    ax = axes[2, 1]\\\\n    outcomes = [int(output_trials[t][1, 0]) for t in range(n_trials)]\\\\n    labels = ['Ignore (0)', 'Miss (1)', 'Hit (2)']\\\\n    ax.bar(labels, [outcomes.count(0), outcomes.count(1), outcomes.count(2)])\\\\n    ax.set_title('Output: Outcome distribution')\\\\n\\\\n    # 7. Output: early lick distribution\\\\n    ax = axes[3, 0]\\\\n    early = [int(output_trials[t][2, 0]) for t in range(n_trials)]\\\\n    ax.bar(['No (0)', 'Yes (1)'], [early.count(0), early.count(1)])\\\\n    ax.set_title('Output: Early lick distribution')\\\\n\\\\n    # 8. Output: tongue y example trial\\\\n    ax = axes[3, 1]\\\\n    ax.plot(bin_centers, tongue_y_raw[trial_idx], label='Raw y')\\\\n    ax.plot(bin_centers, tongue_y_discrete[trial_idx], label='Discretized', linestyle='--')\\\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')\\\\n    ax.set_title(f'Output: Tongue y (trial {trial_idx})')\\\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\\\n    ax.legend()\\\\n\\\\n    # 9. Brain region distribution\\\\n    ax = axes[4, 0]\\\\n    from collections import Counter\\\\n    rc = Counter(region_labels)\\\\n    regions_sorted = sorted(rc.keys(), key=lambda x: -rc[x])\\\\n    ax.barh(range(len(regions_sorted)), [rc[r] for r in regions_sorted])\\\\n    ax.set_yticks(range(len(regions_sorted)))\\\\n    ax.set_yticklabels(regions_sorted)\\\\n    ax.set_title(f'Brain regions ({len(region_labels)} neurons)')\\\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Count')\\\\n\\\\n    # 10. Vectorized implementation: processes all trials for each neuron at once.\\n\\n    Args:\\n        spike_times_list: list of arrays, one per neuron (absolute session times)\\n        go_times: array of side='left')\\n            idx_hi = np.searchsorted(st, abs_end, side='left')\\n\\n            if idx_hi > idx_lo:\\n                rel_spikes = st[idx_lo:idx_hi] - go_t\\n                counts, _ = np.histogram(rel_spikes, bins=bin_edges)\\n                all_matrices[t, n, :] = counts / bin_width\\n\\n    # Convert to list of (n_neurons, n_bins) per trial\\n    return [all_matrices[t] for t in range(n_trials)]\\n\\n\\ndef compute_tongue_y_per_trial(tongue_data, tongue_timestamps, go_times,\\n                                align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins,\\n                                confidence_threshold=TONGUE_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute tongue y-position time series for each trial, binned.\\n\\n    When tongue is occluded (confidence below threshold), set to session mean.\\n    Reference: \\\"when the tongue was occluded... we set the tongue position to its mean value\\\"\\n\\n    Vectorized implementation for efficiency.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    tongue_y = tongue_data[:, 1].astype(np.float64)\\n    tongue_conf = tongue_data[:, 2].astype(np.float64)\\n\\n    # Compute session mean of tongue y when visible\\n    visible_mask = tongue_conf >= confidence_threshold\\n    if np.sum(visible_mask) > 0:\\n        session_mean_y = np.mean(tongue_y[visible_mask])\\n    else:\\n        session_mean_y = np.mean(tongue_y)\\n\\n    # Replace non-visible tongue y with session mean (vectorized)\\n    tongue_y_imputed = tongue_y.copy()\\n    tongue_y_imputed[~visible_mask] = session_mean_y\\n\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(align_start, align_end, n_bins + 1)\\n\\n    tongue_y_trials = []\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\n\\n        # Get tongue data in the trial window\\n        window_start = go_t + align_start\\n        window_end = go_t + align_end\\n        mask = (tongue_timestamps >= window_start) & (tongue_timestamps < window_end)\\n        trial_ts = tongue_timestamps[mask] - go_t  # relative to go cue\\n        trial_y = tongue_y_imputed[mask]\\n\\n        if len(trial_ts) == 0:\\n            tongue_y_trials.append(np.full(n_bins, session_mean_y, dtype=np.float32))\\n            continue\\n\\n        # Bin the tongue y values using digitize (vectorized)\\n        bin_indices = np.digitize(trial_ts, bin_edges) - 1  # 0-indexed bins\\n        bin_indices = np.clip(bin_indices, 0, n_bins - 1)\\n\\n        trial_tongue_y = np.full(n_bins, session_mean_y, dtype=np.float64)\\n        # Use bincount for mean computation\\n        for b in range(n_bins):\\n            in_bin = trial_y[bin_indices == b]\\n            if len(in_bin) > 0:\\n                trial_tongue_y[b] = np.mean(in_bin)\\n\\n        tongue_y_trials.append(trial_tongue_y.astype(np.float32))\\n\\n    return tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y\\n\\n\\ndef discretize_tongue_y(tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Discretize tongue y-position per session.\\n\\n    0: < 40th percentile of y-position over the session\\n    1: 40th to 60th percentile of y-position over the session\\n    2: > 60th percentile of y-position over the session\\n\\n    Percentiles are computed over ALL time bins (including imputed values).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Collect all tongue y values across all trials and time bins\\n    all_values = np.concatenate([t for t in tongue_y_trials])\\n\\n    p40 = np.percentile(all_values, 40)\\n    p60 = np.percentile(all_values, 60)\\n\\n    # Ensure thresholds differ to get 3 categories\\n    # If p40 == p60 (common when tongue is mostly at mean), adjust slightly\\n    if np.isclose(p40, p60):\\n        # Use small offset to create 3 categories\\n        eps = max(1e-6, abs(p40) * 1e-4)\\n        p40 = p40 - eps\\n        p60 = p60 + eps\\n\\n    discretized = []\\n    for trial_y in tongue_y_trials:\\n        d = np.zeros(len(trial_y), dtype=np.int64)\\n        d[trial_y >= p40] = 1\\n        d[trial_y >= p60] = 2\\n        discretized.append(d)\\n\\n    return discretized\\n\\n\\ndef compute_photostim_input(go_times, photostim_start_ts, photostim_stop_ts,\\n                            align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute binary photostimulation time series for each trial.\\n\\n    1 when photostim is active, 0 otherwise.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(align_start + bin_width/2, align_end - bin_width/2, n_bins)\\n\\n    photostim_trials = []\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\n        ps = np.zeros(n_bins, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n        for si in range(len(photostim_start_ts)):\\n            ps_start = photostim_start_ts[si] - go_t\\n            ps_stop = photostim_stop_ts[si] - go_t\\n\\n            # Check if this photostim event overlaps with our window\\n            if ps_stop < align_start or ps_start > align_end:\\n                continue\\n\\n            # Mark bins where photostim is active\\n            for b in range(n_bins):\\n                bc = bin_centers[b]\\n                if bc >= ps_start and bc < ps_stop:\\n                    ps[b] = 1.0\\n\\n        photostim_trials.append(ps)\\n\\n    return photostim_trials\\n\\n\\ndef compute_tone_onset_input(go_times, tone_onsets, align_start, align_end, bin_width, n_bins):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute time from tone onset for each trial and time bin.\\n\\n    This is a continuous, time-varying input: time (in seconds) since the\\n    tone (sample stimulus) began.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(align_start + bin_width/2, align_end - bin_width/2, n_bins)\\n\\n    tone_onset_input = []\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\n        tone_t = tone_onsets[t]\\n\\n        if np.isnan(tone_t):\\n            # If no tone onset found, set to 0 (shouldn't happen for valid trials)\\n            tone_input = np.zeros(n_bins, dtype=np.float32)\\n        else:\\n            # Time from tone onset = (absolute time of bin center) - tone_onset\\n            # = (go_t + bin_center) - tone_t\\n            # = bin_center - (tone_t - go_t)\\n            tone_rel = tone_t - go_t  # tone onset relative to go cue (negative)\\n            tone_input = (bin_centers - tone_rel).astype(np.float32)\\n\\n        tone_onset_input.append(tone_input)\\n\\n    return tone_onset_input\\n\\n\\ndef process_session(nwb_path, show_processing=False, session_idx=0):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process a single NWB session into decoder format.\\n\\n    Returns None if session doesn't meet selection criteria.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    t0 = time.time()\\n    sess_name = os.path.basename(nwb_path).replace('.nwb', '')\\n    print(f'  Loading {sess_name}...')\\n\\n    data = load_nwb_session(nwb_path)\\n    t_load = time.time() - t0\\n\\n    # === Session selection criteria ===\\n    performance, correct_left, correct_right = compute_session_performance(data['trials_data'])\\n    print(f'    Performance: {performance:.1%}, Correct L/R: {correct_left}/{correct_right}')\\n\\n    if performance < MIN_PERFORMANCE:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: performance {performance:.1%} < {MIN_PERFORMANCE:.0%}')\\n        return None\\n    if correct_left < MIN_CORRECT_LEFT:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: correct left {correct_left} < {MIN_CORRECT_LEFT}')\\n        return None\\n    if correct_right < MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: correct right {correct_right} < {MIN_CORRECT_RIGHT}')\\n        return None\\n\\n    # === Trial filtering: exclude auto_water and free_water ===\\n    td = data['trials_data']\\n    trial_mask = np.ones(data['n_trials'], dtype=bool)\\n    trial_mask[td['auto_water'] == 1] = False\\n    trial_mask[td['free_water'] == 1] = False\\n\\n    # Get trial indices\\n    trial_indices = np.where(trial_mask)[0]\\n    n_valid_trials = len(trial_indices)\\n\\n    if n_valid_trials < 2:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: only {n_valid_trials} valid trials')\\n        return None\\n\\n    go_times = data['go_times'][trial_indices]\\n\\n    # === Neuron filtering: only good units with valid brain region ===\\n    good_anno = data['good_anno_names']\\n    region_labels = []\\n    neuron_mask = []\\n    for i, anno in enumerate(good_anno):\\n        region = map_anno_to_region(anno)\\n        if region is not None:\\n            region_labels.append(region)\\n            neuron_mask.append(i)\\n\\n    neuron_mask = np.array(neuron_mask)\\n    n_neurons = len(neuron_mask)\\n\\n    if n_neurons < 1:\\n        print(f'    SKIP: no neurons with valid brain region')\\n        return None\\n\\n    spike_times_list = [data['good_spike_times'][i] for i in neuron_mask]\\n\\n    # === Exclude trials beyond recording range ===\\n    # Some sessions have behavioral trials before recording starts or after it ends.\\n    # Find the min/max spike time across all selected neurons.\\n    max_spike_time = max(\\n        (st[-1] if len(st) > 0 else 0.0) for st in spike_times_list\\n    )\\n    min_spike_time = min(\\n        (st[0] if len(st) > 0 else float('inf')) for st in spike_times_list\\n    )\\n    # A trial needs neural data in [go_time + ALIGN_START, go_time + ALIGN_END].\\n    # Exclude trials where the window doesn't overlap with recorded data.\\n    recording_mask = (go_times + ALIGN_START <= max_spike_time) & \\\\\\n                     (go_times + ALIGN_END >= min_spike_time)\\n    if not np.all(recording_mask):\\n        n_dropped = np.sum(~recording_mask)\\n        print(f'    Excluding {n_dropped} trials beyond recording range (max spike: {max_spike_time:.1f}s)')\\n        # Update trial_indices and go_times\\n        valid_positions = np.where(recording_mask)[0]\\n        trial_indices = trial_indices[valid_positions]\\n        go_times = go_times[valid_positions]\\n        n_valid_trials = len(trial_indices)\\n        if n_valid_trials < 2:\\n            print(f'    SKIP: only {n_valid_trials} valid trials after recording filter')\\n            return None\\n\\n    print(f'    Neurons: {n_neurons}, Trials: {n_valid_trials} (loaded in {t_load:.1f}s)')\\n\\n    # === Bin spikes into firing rates ===\\n    t1 = time.time()\\n    neural_trials = bin_spikes(spike_times_list, go_times, ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS)\\n    t_bin = time.time() - t1\\n    print(f'    Spike binning: {t_bin:.1f}s')\\n\\n    # === Compute inputs ===\\n    # 1. Time from tone onset\\n    tone_onsets = get_tone_onset_for_trials(\\n        go_times, data['sample_start_ts'],\\n        td['start_time'][trial_indices], td['stop_time'][trial_indices]\\n    )\\n    tone_onset_input = compute_tone_onset_input(go_times, tone_onsets, ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS)\\n\\n    # 2. Choice: left=0, right=1\\n    instructions = td['trial_instruction'][trial_indices]\\n    choices = np.array([0 if ins == 'left' else 1 for ins in instructions], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # 2. Outcome: ignore=0, miss=1, hit=2\\n    outcomes_raw = td['outcome'][trial_indices]\\n    outcome_map = {'ignore': 0, 'miss': 1, 'hit': 2}\\n    outcomes = np.array([outcome_map.get(o, 0) for o in outcomes_raw], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # 3. Early lick: no=0, yes=1\\n    early_lick_raw = td['early_lick'][trial_indices]\\n    early_licks = np.array([1 if el == 'early' else 0 for el in early_lick_raw], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # 4. Tongue y-position (time-varying, discretized)\\n    t2 = time.time()\\n    tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y = compute_tongue_y_per_trial(\\n        data['tongue_data'], data['tongue_timestamps'], go_times,\\n        ALIGN_START, ALIGN_END, BIN_WIDTH, N_BINS\\n    )\\n    tongue_y_discrete = discretize_tongue_y(tongue_y_trials, session_mean_y)\\n    t_tongue = time.time() - t2\\n    print(f'    Tongue processing: {t_tongue:.1f}s')\\n\\n    # Combine outputs: per-trial for first 3, time-varying for tongue\\n    output_trials = []\\n    for t in range(n_valid_trials):\\n        out = np.array([\\n            np.full(N_BINS, choices[t], dtype=np.int64),         # choice (per-trial, broadcast)\\n            np.full(N_BINS, outcomes[t], dtype=np.int64),        # outcome (per-trial, broadcast)\\n            np.full(N_BINS, early_licks[t], dtype=np.int64),     # early lick (per-trial, broadcast)\\n            tongue_y_discrete[t].astype(np.int64),                # tongue y (time-varying)\\n        ], dtype=np.int64)\\n        output_trials.append(out)\\n\\n    # === Plotting ===\\n    if show_processing:\\n        plot_processing(sess_name, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\n                       go_times, tone_onsets, tongue_y_trials, tongue_y_discrete,\\n                       region_labels, session_idx)\\n\\n    total_time = time.time() - t0\\n    print(f'    Total: {total_time:.1f}s')\\n\\n    return {\\n        'neural': neural_trials,          # list of (n_neurons, n_bins)\\n        'input': input_trials,            # list of (2, n_bins)\\n        'output': output_trials,          # list of (4, n_bins)\\n        'subject_id': data['subject_id'],\\n        'subject_desc': data['subject_desc'],\\n        'region_labels': region_labels,   # list of str, length n_neurons\\n        'n_neurons': n_neurons,\\n        'n_trials': n_valid_trials,\\n        'performance': performance,\\n        'correct_left': correct_left,\\n        'correct_right': correct_right,\\n        'nwb_path': nwb_path,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef plot_processing(sess_name, neural_trials, input_trials, output_trials,\\n                   go_times, tone_onsets, tongue_y_raw, tongue_y_discrete,\\n                   region_labels, session_idx):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Plot visualizations of processing steps.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    import matplotlib\\n    matplotlib.use('Agg')\\n    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\n\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(ALIGN_START + BIN_WIDTH/2, ALIGN_END - BIN_WIDTH/2, N_BINS)\\n\\n    fig, axes = plt.subplots(5, 2, figsize=(16, 20))\\n    fig.suptitle(f'Processing: {sess_name}', fontsize=14)\\n\\n    # Pick example trial\\n    n_trials = len(neural_trials)\\n    trial_idx = min(5, n_trials - 1)\\n\\n    # 1. Input: time from tone onset\\n    ax = axes[1, 0]\\n    for t in range(min(10, n_trials)):\\n        ax.plot(bin_centers, input_trials[t][0], alpha=0.5)\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')\\n    ax.set_title('Input: Time from tone onset')\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\n    ax.set_ylabel('Time from tone (s)')\\n\\n    # 4. Input: photostimulation\\n    ax = axes[1, 1]\\n    ps_any = np.any([input_trials[t][1] for t in range(n_trials)], axis=0)\\n    n_stim = sum(1 for t in range(n_trials) if np.any(input_trials[t][1] > 0))\\n    ax.plot(bin_centers, np.mean([input_trials[t][1] for t in range(n_trials)], axis=0))\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')\\n    ax.set_title(f'Input: Photostim (mean, {n_stim}/{n_trials} stim trials)')\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\n    ax.set_ylabel('P(stim on)')\\n\\n    # 5. Output: early lick distribution\\n    ax = axes[3, 0]\\n    early = [int(output_trials[t][2, 0]) for t in range(n_trials)]\\n    ax.bar(['No (0)', 'Yes (1)'], [early.count(0), early.count(1)])\\n    ax.set_title('Output: Early lick distribution')\\n\\n    # 8. Output: tongue y example trial\\n    ax = axes[3, 1]\\n    ax.plot(bin_centers, tongue_y_raw[trial_idx], label='Raw y')\\n    ax.plot(bin_centers, tongue_y_discrete[trial_idx], label='Discretized', linestyle='--')\\n    ax.axvline(0, color='r', linestyle='--')\\n    ax.set_title(f'Output: Tongue y (trial {trial_idx})')\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Time from go cue (s)')\\n    ax.legend()\\n\\n    # 9. Brain region distribution\\n    ax = axes[4, 0]\\n    from collections import Counter\\n    rc = Counter(region_labels)\\n    regions_sorted = sorted(rc.keys(), key=lambda x: -rc[x])\\n    ax.barh(range(len(regions_sorted)), [rc[r] for r in regions_sorted])\\n    ax.set_yticks(range(len(regions_sorted)))\\n    ax.set_yticklabels(regions_sorted)\\n    ax.set_title(f'Brain regions ({len(region_labels)} neurons)')\\n    ax.set_xlabel('Count')\\n\\n    # 10. Pick 2 sessions from different subjects (middle of dataset for better chance of passing criteria)\\n        idx1 = len(nwb_files) // 3\\n        idx2 = 2 * len(nwb_files) // 3\\n        nwb_files = [nwb_files[idx1], nwb_files[idx2]]\\n        print(f'Sample mode: processing {len(nwb_files)} sessions')\\n\\n    # Process sessions\\n    all_sessions = []\\n    subjects_set = OrderedDict()\\n    all_regions_set = set()\\n\\n    for i, nwb_path in enumerate(nwb_files):\\n        print(f'\\\\n[{i+1}/{len(nwb_files)}] Processing {os.path.basename(nwb_path)}')\\n\\n        result = process_session(\\n            nwb_path,\\n            show_processing=show_processing and i < 2,\\n            session_idx=i\\n        )\\n\\n        if result is None:\\n            continue\\n\\n        all_sessions.append(result)\\n        sid = result['subject_id']\\n        if sid not in subjects_set:\\n            subjects_set[sid] = len(subjects_set)\\n\\n        for r in result['region_labels']:\\n            all_regions_set.add(r)\\n\\n    n_sessions = len(all_sessions)\\n    print(f'\\\\n=== Processed {n_sessions} sessions ===')\\n\\n    if n_sessions == 0:\\n        print('ERROR: No valid sessions')\\n        sys.exit(1)\\n\\n    # === Build output data structure ===\\n    subjects = list(subjects_set.keys())\\n    brain_regions = sorted(all_regions_set)\\n    brain_region_to_idx = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(brain_regions)}\\n\\n    neural = []\\n    inputs = []\\n    outputs = []\\n    subject_idx = []\\n    brain_region_idx = []\\n\\n    for sess in all_sessions:\\n        neural.append(sess['neural'])\\n        inputs.append(sess['input'])\\n        outputs.append(sess['output'])\\n        subject_idx.append(subjects_set[sess['subject_id']])\\n\\n        # Map region labels to indices\\n        ridx = np.array([brain_region_to_idx[r] for r in sess['region_labels']], dtype=np.int64)\\n        brain_region_idx.append(ridx)\\n\\n    subject_idx = np.array(subject_idx, dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    # === Construct final data dict ===\\n    data = {\\n        'neural': neural,\\n        'input': inputs,\\n        'output': outputs,\\n        'subjects': subjects,\\n        'subject_idx': subject_idx,\\n        'brain_regions': brain_regions,\\n        'brain_region_idx': brain_region_idx,\\n        'input_names': ['time_from_tone_onset', 'photostim_on'],\\n        'output_names': ['choice', 'outcome', 'early_lick', 'tongue_y_position'],\\n        'output_values': [\\n            ['left', 'right'],                    # choice: 0=left, 1=right\\n            ['ignore', 'miss', 'hit'],            # outcome: 0=ignore, 1=miss, 2=hit\\n            ['no', 'yes'],                        # early_lick: 0=no, 1=yes\\n            ['low', 'mid', 'high'],               # tongue_y: 0=<40th, 1=40-60th, 2=>60th\\n        ],\\n        'metadata': {\\n            'task_description': 'Auditory delayed-response directional licking task. Mice lick left or right based on tone frequency (3kHz or 12kHz) after a 1.2s delay following a go cue.',\\n            'time_bin_size': BIN_WIDTH * 1000,  # in ms\\n            'temporal_alignment_event': 'Go cue onset',\\n            'off_start': ALIGN_START,  # -2.5s\\n            'off_end': ALIGN_END,      # +1.5s\\n            'n_sessions': n_sessions,\\n            'n_subjects': len(subjects),\\n            'session_info': [\\n                {\\n                    'nwb_path': sess['nwb_path'],\\n                    'subject_id': sess['subject_id'],\\n                    'subject_desc': sess['subject_desc'],\\n                    'n_neurons': sess['n_neurons'],\\n                    'n_trials': sess['n_trials'],\\n                    'performance': Vectorized implementation: processes all trials for each neuron at once.\\n\\n    Args:\\n        spike_times_list: list of arrays, one per neuron (absolute session times)\\n        go_times: array of go cue times (one per trial)\\n        align_start: time before go cue (negative)\\n        align_end: time after go cue (positive)\\n        bin_width: bin width in seconds\\n        n_bins: number of bins\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        list of (n_neurons, n_bins) arrays, one per trial\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_neurons = len(spike_times_list)\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n\\n    # Precompute bin edges relative to alignment\\n    bin_edges = np.linspace(align_start, align_end, n_bins + 1)\\n\\n    # Pre-allocate all trial matrices at once: (n_trials, n_neurons, n_bins)\\n    all_matrices =         confidence_threshold=TONGUE_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute tongue y-position time series for each trial, binned.\\n\\n    When tongue is occluded (confidence below \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    tongue_y = tongue_data[:, 1].astype(np.float64)\\n    tongue_conf = tongue_data[:, 2].astype(np.float64)\\n\\n    # Compute session mean of tongue y when visible\\n    visible_mask over the session\\n\\n    Percentiles are computed over ALL time bins (including imputed values).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Collect all tongue y values across all trials and time bins\\n    all_values = np.concatenate([t for t in tongue_y_trials])\\n\\n    p40 = np.percentile(all_values, 40)\\n    p60 = np.percentile(all_values, 60)\\n\\n    # Ensure thresholds differ to get 3 categories\\n    # If p40 == p60 (common when tongue is mostly at mean), adjust slightly\\n    if np.isclose(p40, p60):\\n        # Use small offset to create 3 categories\\n        eps = max(1e-6, abs(p40) * 1e-4)\\n        p40 = p40 - eps\\n        p60 = p60 + eps\\n\\n    discretized = []\\n    for trial_y in tongue_y_trials:\\n        d = np.zeros(len(trial_y), dtype=np.int64)\\n        d[trial_y >= p40] = 1\\n        d[trial_y >= p60] = 2\\n        discretized.append(d)\\n\\n    return discretized\\n\\n\\ndef compute_photostim_input(go_times, photostim_start_ts, active, 0 otherwise.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_trials = len(go_times)\\n    bin_centers = np.linspace(align_start + bin_width/2, align_end - bin_width/2, n_bins)\\n\\n    photostim_trials = []\\n    for t in range(n_trials):\\n        go_t = go_times[t]\\n        ps = np.zeros(n_bins, dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n        for si in range(len(photostim_start_ts)):\\n            ps_start = photostim_start_ts[si] - go_t\\n            ps_stop = photostim_stop_ts[si] - go_t\\n\\n            # Check if this photostim event overlaps with our window\\n            if ps_stop < align_start or
